notes.title: Dicealot Next-Fest Playtest
notes.notes:
[b]Thank you for registering your interest in playtesting Dicealot![/b]

Look for out for our full demo next week which features even more content!

Please be gentle and share all of your thoughts here on our community [url=https://discord.gg/94Ha7bRh]Discord[/url].

Our gaming moments are precious, and we are humbled that you have chosen to give some of yours to embolden Camelot.

Much love,
